title: A card with some depth
description: Six translucent amber planes shift against a deep frame as a sculpture follows the pointer.
useCase: Give a featured collectible or artwork depth through actual layered geometry.
interaction: Move the pointer, drag, or use arrow keys to tilt
reducedMotion: The artwork remains at a fixed viewing angle; pointer and keyboard tilting are disabled.
limitations: Six original translucent planes and a deep frame projected into one SVG; not physically traced glass. Uses Motion for spring tracking.
look: Warm grey background with a cream-rimmed deep shadow-box frame, dark slate interior and a stack of translucent glowing amber discs at its centre.
motion: Pointer movement tilts the deep frame and six amber planes in projected 3D, up to 18° each way, on a spring (stiffness 230, damping 26); leaving springs back to rest.
adapt: `useSpring` smooths the `x` and `y` motion values, and `draw` calls `geometry` on each change to rewrite SVG path `d` attributes (`box`, `planes`, `rim`). Tune the spring and the 36° range in `geometry`; replace its elliptical `planes` with your own layered shapes.
